t: Besides the bees producing resources there are a few bees with special tasks.
除了会产出资源的蜜蜂外，还有少数蜜蜂承担着特殊任务。
Will harvest nearby crops and leave the produce on the ground.
会收割附近的作物，并把收成留在地上。
Will milk nearby cows and create milky combs in it's hive.
会给附近的牛挤奶，并在蜂箱里产出牛奶蜜脾。
Collects items on the ground and puts them in it's hive.$(br)Combine with the farmer bee for an automated farm.
会捡起地上的物品放进蜂箱。$(br)与农夫蜜蜂搭配即可做出自动农场。
Nibble on nearby wood and collects wood chips in it's hive. Wood chips can be crafted into logs.
会啃食附近的木头，把木屑收进蜂箱。木屑可以合成原木。
Nibble on nearby stone, sand or gravel and collects stone chips in it's hive. Stone chips can be crafted into it's counterpart block.
会啃食附近的石头、沙子或砂砾，把石屑收进蜂箱。石屑可以合成回对应的方块。
Produces dye based on the flower it has pollinated.
根据它授粉过的花朵产出对应的染料。
The pheromones secreted from this bee gets animals in the mood.
这种蜜蜂分泌的信息素会让动物进入繁殖状态。
